capabilities: Merge cells and define multi-row column headers and row headers with <, ^, and || markers
Edit and rearrange table cells, rows, and columns in Live Preview
Convert tables between extended Markdown, plain GFM, and standalone HTML with previews
Transpose whole tables and paste HTML tables from browsers, Excel, or Google Sheets
Copy tables as HTML, GFM, TSV, or CSV, export a PNG, or convert a table into an Obsidian Base
extras: The headerless-table and row-header syntax deliberately deviates from GFM, so those tables may not render in other Markdown editors; the author apologized for this and added Markdown/HTML conversion as a workaround. Conflicting syntax with other table plugins triggers a one-time warning. PNG export is desktop-only; Word export via DocWen supports Windows and Linux only. Requires Obsidian 1.12.7+.
motivation: The author built it for his own niche needs while working with academic papers in Obsidian, extending Markdown as a substitute for the small part of LaTeX he used.
problem: Obsidian's native Markdown tables only support plain GFM structure, so users cannot render merged cells, stacked column headers, or row-header columns in notes.

relations.evidence: DocWen Assistant can work with the separate local DocWen application.

summary: Markdown table plugin that adds merged cells, multi-row headers, and row headers, with in-place editing, GFM/HTML conversion, PNG export, and Base conversion.
